source_notes: Kept: square card corners with round stroke joins (the sheet's inner corners are square); the shoulder sides running straight down into the card top; each mark as one short horizontal stroke in the card's upper-middle area. The marks are drawn at W by the reviewer's decision, though the sheet draws them heavier. Red is the three marks only; both sheets agree on placement.
